purpose: Candidate-independent fixed source-time outcomes for replaying when fictional SOP claims and a separately evidenced decision-register record become knowable.
oracle_policy: All values are fixed from the exact timeline task packet, accepted decision-provenance packet/oracles, and unchanged SOP-impact/handover source oracles. Candidate responses, UI text, query results, fixtures, and browser output never supply or amend expected values.

scope.knowledge_time: Filter each node-to-node EVIDENCED_BY source by observed_at <= normalized known_at; observed_at is when synthetic evidence was observed, not effective time or a claim of real-world truth.
scope.pre_record_claim_source: Before 2026-10-14T16:05:00Z, discover claims only via the accepted SOP-impact APPLIES_TO/CLAIMS_ROLE/EVIDENCED_BY path. Never discover claims via a future decision record or its CONSIDERS edges.
scope.record_visibility: Reveal register, decision record, own source, and CONSIDERS edges only after the record's own EVIDENCED_BY source is known; render a CONSIDERS edge only to independently evidence-known claim nodes.
scope.unknown_semantics: Not observed by cutoff or missing evidence is unknown/incomplete, never proof of nonexistence, no conflict, resolution, current owner, or safety.
scope.citation_semantics: A source fact requires the corresponding node-to-node EVIDENCED_BY edge; a property or timestamp alone is insufficient.
scope.conflict_semantics: SOP_CONFLICT is a graph-derived relationship, not an evidence quotation or authoritative procedure; show only when both source-backed claims are visible.
scope.acl_semantics: The complete operations projection, visible counts, browser text and accessibility view remain invariant to denied/restricted source injection; no inaccessible IDs, titles, facts, counts, paths, relationships, existence, or paraphrases leak.
